reviewSamples.author: Geoffrey Branch
reviewSamples.text: Both my cars had been severely neglected when I found this company working on a vehicle for my mom’s neighbor.  I inquired, quickly received a quote, and BOTH my cars were scheduled and completed within a week or so, and they look Fantastic!  Highly recommend.

reviewSamples.author: Lori Smith
reviewSamples.text: GUI is the best! Top notch detail. My truck looks better than it did the day I drive it off the showroom floor. Very, very detailed, professional, and responsive. I highly recommend this team!!

reviewSamples.author: cathy kornbluth
reviewSamples.text: Saw a post on Nextdoor about GUI detailing. Reviews were great. So hired them to do a complete wash , wax and detail. Price was very fair in comparison to time and attention to detail that was put into the service. I would definitely call them again and recommend to anyone.

reviewSamples.author: Victoria Peck
reviewSamples.text: I highly and wholeheartedly recommend Gui!! The tech was prompt, polite and very friendly. The work was amazing. Bruno paid such attention to detail and my car looks better than it did in the showroom. I appreciate the effort. Gui is quick to respond to texts and a great communicator. Great company to deal with all around!!!!
